To find the scale parameter of the normal distribution, we identify that the scale parameter is the standard deviation ($\sigma$). Given the variance ($\sigma^2$) of the measurement $W$ is 49:

$\text{Variance} (\sigma^2) = 49$
$\text{Standard Deviation} (\sigma) = \sqrt{\text{Variance}}$
$\sigma = \sqrt{49}$
$\sigma = 7$

The numerical value of the scale parameter (standard deviation) is 7.

<ANSWER>7</ANSWER>
